Willy’s surgery was only possible because of an incredible team. 🤍 From the weeks of planning to four hours in surgery, this case brought together talented vets, nurses and support staff who all shared one goal: giving Willy the best chance at a happy, pain-free life. What makes this even more special is that it all happened in a donation-funded animal shelter. ❤️ Every piece of equipment, every anaesthetic, every hour spent planning and operating, and every day of recovery is made possible because our community believes that dogs like Willy deserve a second chance. I’m so proud to work alongside such an extraordinary team at AWL. Together, we were able to perform a surgery that had never been done before and give one very special boy the future he deserved. Thank you to everyone who supports AWL—whether you donate, foster, volunteer or simply share our stories. You are changing lives, and Willy is proof of that. 🐾🤍 #vet #vetlife #veterinarian #sheltervet #vetsurgery

📚Build a Study Schedule That Actually Works 1. Count the weeks until your exam, then divide your syllabus across those weeks. Know your pace. 2. Build buffer weeks into your schedule — life happens. Flexible plans survive, rigid ones collapse. 3. Assign subjects to specific days: don't try to cover all subjects daily. Batch by subject for depth. 4. Schedule review sessions BEFORE new content — start each week by reviewing the previous week first. 5. Your peak energy hours should be reserved for hardest subjects. Schedule light review for low-energy times. 6. Review your study schedule every Sunday. What worked? What didn't? Adjust and move forward. #StudyTok #StudyMotivation #ExamPrep #StudyHacks #StudyWithMe

I went to korea's first maid cafe in hongdae to understand why there is a massive demand for these spaces in Seoul.  there was a food or beverage minimum (starting around ₩9,000 / $7.50), and you are forbidden from directly filming the maids' faces. the experience can be a social anxiety simulator for introverts - you have to make cat sounds to call the maids and cast a spell (moe moe kyun) on your food before you can even eat!  the maids were incredibly warm and skilled at active listening; we played games and had deep conversations with one maid who is a philosophy major. it feels like we paid for undivided, warm human connection.  would you try this? #seoul #hongdae #maidcafe #moemoekyun #japan #koreanculture #hongdaeboys
